name: io.github.bosmdavid-gif/dropthehassle
title: DropTheHassle
description: Your AI puts your site online on a free link with HTTPS. Your own .com later. No token needed.

environmentVariables.name: DTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Not needed to put a site online. Only for account tools: dropthehassle.com, menu, Connect your AI.

tools.name: deploy_site
tools.description: Put your site online on a free link with HTTPS, or update it. No account needed to start.

tools.name: search_domain
tools.description: Check if a domain is free and what it costs. It never buys.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Show what works right now, and which account is connected.

tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: List the sites on your account with their live links.

tools.name: choose_link
tools.description: Rename a site's free link after you say yes. The old link keeps working.

tools.name: set_backend
tools.description: Link your server part on AWS, Google Cloud, DigitalOcean or your own server to your site.

tools.name: point_domain
tools.description: Move a domain already on your account to one of your sites. It never buys.

tools.name: get_checkout_link
tools.description: Give you a payment link for your own .com. You open it and pay. Your AI never can.
